1000072773732052992.a: I own a sea of @IndyCar and some @NASCAR racing photos. I need an inspiring project and a modest wage for now. Anyone want to fund and/or help organize a project to catalog and archive this subculture for the public good? These cover late 80s past the end of CART IndyCar at @IMS

1000072775128834048.a: Some open-wheel & dirt. Some film. These are mostly taken with a Canon EOS 35mm film camera by myself or my mother. 4x6 photos, negatives, and undeveloped canisters. Two to three 18 gallon boxes. She took decent shots and I was a school newspaper photographer part of that time.

1000073452466921473.a: I would like to see some made into artbooks or something people can hold and share with friends. I would like ALL of them to go somewhere like archive.org where they can be viewed by everyone forever.

1000073867011022849.a: I have a little bit of experience making a photo book like this. I have a print example in B&W. It's not fancy with decorations but I think the simplicity makes the photos stand out. I wanted viewers to focus on the subjects.
